option_relations.rationale: Right ventricular infarction is a specific type of myocardial infarction, which is a form of acute myocardial infarction.

Mirror-image dextrocardia with acute inferior wall and right ventricular myocardial infarction due to proximal right coronary artery occlusion describes a specific presentation of acute myocardial infarction, making it a subtype.
Acute inferior-lateral ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) is a specific type of acute myocardial infarction.
Acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction due to proximal right coronary artery occlusion is a specific type of acute myocardial infarction.
